title: Distribution declares no interpreter floor
description: setup.cfg declares a setup.cfg with no `python_requires`. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a setup.cfg with no `python_requires`.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a setup.cfg with no `python_requires`.
limitation: It matches a setup.cfg with no `python_requires` in the parsed setup.cfg; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
